text:
alex: starting config-only deploy in the 00:30-01:00 PT window. changes: max_concurrency 48->32, timeout 55s->40s, batch_window 10ms->5ms, routing weight slight shift. canary plan: 1% -> 8% -> 100%. notes: https://go/release/2026-03-thin-sprint
release-manager: please add preflight checklist link and set abort guards: p95 +20% or 5xx_rate >0.5% for 2m. pin fallback route policy: route:stable-v1
chi: can we distribute canary across 3 AZs and two instance classes? also will pre-warm KV cache for top tenants.
sre: monitoring p95, 5xx, kv_cache_miss, gpu_mem. alert if 5xx >0.5% sustained 2m or p95 > baseline*1.2.
alex: deploying config snippet:
```json
{
  "max_concurrency": 32,
  "timeout_s": 40,
  "batch_window_ms": 5,
  "routing_weights": {"canary-mini": 1, "default": 99}
}
```
deploybot: release "thin-sprint-config-2026-03" queued by alex. steps: validate -> canary(1%) -> wait(10m) -> canary(8%) -> wait(15m) -> ramp(100%). preflight smoke running.
deploybot: preflight smoke OK
chi: warm_kv_cache run for tenants T1,T2. canary(1%) starting now.
deploybot: canary(1%) started at 00:33:05 PT. distributing across AZs.
sre: initial look: p95 flat, kv_cache_miss +10% expected, no 5xx.
deploybot: canary(1%) passed 10m gate, moving to 8% at 00:44:15 PT.
chi: at 8% we see a small 5xx uptick concentrated on tenant Z. adding tenant Z to exclude list and enabling fallback route for Z.
sre: tenant-exclude Z applied. system-wide 5xx back under threshold. recommend continue.
deploybot: ramp to 100% started at 00:58:50 PT. final checks OK.
alex: post-ramp p95 improved ~7%, cost slightly down. tagging config commit cfg@abc123. closing change window early at 01:02.
release-manager: great job. will file post-deploy summary tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:
